gloss: to talk someone into; to win over; to cajole

definitions.gloss: to talk someone into; to win someone over; to cajole
definitions.explanation: To get someone to agree or go along by clever talk, flattery, or persuasion, usually against their better judgment. Implies some manipulation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丸|まる}め{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: He sweet-talked the customer with a too-good-to-be-true pitch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}していた→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸|まる}め{込|こ}まれてしまった。
examples.english: The department head, who had been against it at first, was won over by her in the end.

notes:
⟦{丸|まる}める→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧ (to make round; to roll up) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The image is of rolling someone up into one's own plans. Often in the passive, {丸|まる}め{込|こ}まれる (to be talked into it).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言葉巧|ことばたく}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸|まる}め{込|こ}む: to win someone over with smooth talk
- ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧{丸|まる}め{込|こ}む: to talk someone round skillfully
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸|まる}め{込|こ}まれる: to be talked into it by the other side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}いくるめる→言いくるめる：23414_iikurumeru⟧: to talk someone into (by twisting words) — stresses verbal trickery
- ⟦{説得|せっとく}する→説得する：21139_settokusuru⟧: to persuade — neutral, no hint of manipulation
- ⟦{騙|だま}す→騙す：02286_damasu⟧: to deceive — outright lying
